sealed.note: The three shapes were pre-registered in case.yaml on 2026-11-14. The manifest was frozen on 2026-11-15, after the candidate already existed, so this is a held-out-shape check, not a blind sealed read.
sealed.note_zh: 三个形状在 2026-11-14 已预注册在 case.yaml 中。manifest 直到 2026-11-15、候选已存在后才冻结，因此这是留出形状复核，不是盲测封存。

e2e.method: One merged gate_up GEMM per MLP; only the activation changes. Cache build is outside every window.
e2e.boundary: The model-level result is a boundary condition, not a null result. A 4096-token prefill is launch-bound: CPU enqueue is about 238 ms of the 506 ms step and GPU drain is 269 ms. The activation takes 16.1 ms of GPU time on the shipped path and 7.8 ms fused, yet wall time moves by about 1 ms, and deleting the activation entirely still takes 505–506 ms. The 1.92x operator win converts only when the step is GPU-bound.
e2e.boundary_zh: 模型层结果是一个边界条件，不是空结果。4096 token 的 prefill 是发射受限的：506 ms 的一步里 CPU 入队约占 238 ms，GPU 排空占 269 ms。激活在现有路径上占 16.1 ms GPU 时间，融合后为 7.8 ms，但 wall 只变动约 1 ms；把激活整个删掉也仍需 505–506 ms。算子层 1.92× 的收益，只有在步骤变成 GPU 受限时才会兑现。

p3.note: Exploratory timings were collected on this host (p3/evidence/, 8 operators, 20 rounds, L2 flush), but no registered P3 selection was run: the pool has no low-bit arms and no accuracy trials, and the policy's task and accuracy scope was not reconciled. No low-bit claim is made.
p3.note_zh: 已在本机采集探索性计时（p3/evidence/，8 个算子，20 轮，L2 flush），但没有运行注册过的 P3 选择：池里没有低比特臂，也没有精度 trial，且策略的任务与精度口径尚未对齐。因此不做任何低比特声明。

caveats.en: One host. All published numbers come from a single AutoDL RTX 6000D. Five pre-registered case templates carry no measurement data and must be re-measured on third-party cloud hardware before they can produce a verdict.
caveats.zh: 单机。所有已发布数字均来自一台 AutoDL RTX 6000D。五个预注册案例模板不含测量数据，须在三方云硬件上重新测量后才能产生判决。

caveats.en: The sealed set is a post-hoc freeze. Shapes were pre-registered, but the manifest was frozen after the candidate existed.
caveats.zh: 封存集是事后冻结。形状确实预注册过，但 manifest 在候选存在之后才冻结。

caveats.en: The end-to-end run swaps only the MLP activation and merges gate_up. Attention, quantization and sampler kernels are untouched.
caveats.zh: 端到端只替换 MLP 激活并合并 gate_up，注意力、量化和采样Kernel都未改动。

caveats.en: The model-level result is a boundary condition, not a null result. The 4096-token prefill is launch-bound (CPU enqueue about 238 ms of a 506 ms step); saving 8.3 ms of activation GPU time does not move wall time, and deleting the activation entirely still takes 505–506 ms. Fusion converts only when the step is GPU-bound.
caveats.zh: 模型层结果是边界条件，不是空结果。4096 token 的 prefill 是发射受限的（506 ms 的一步里 CPU 入队约 238 ms）；省下 8.3 ms 激活 GPU 时间不会改变 wall，把激活整个删掉也仍需 505–506 ms。只有步骤变成 GPU 受限时，融合才会兑现。

caveats.en: No multi-GPU or multi-run claim. Every interval is a 95% paired bootstrap on one host and one session.
caveats.zh: 不声明多卡或多轮结论。所有区间都是单机单次会话上的 95% 配对 bootstrap。

caveats.en: P3 is pending. The pool has no accuracy trials yet, so mechanism classes cannot be cited from it.
caveats.zh: P3 尚未完成。池里还没有精度 trial，因此不能引用任何机制类别结论。
